lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
lobby.title: One night. One vote. No mercy. 🌙
lobby.text: Each phone secretly receives a role — two players are werewolves. Everyone does one hidden night action on their own phone, then FIVE minutes of loud accusations in the room, then a vote. Village wins if a wolf goes down. Roles may have been SWAPPED in the night… even yours.
night.title: Night falls — total silence
night.body: Do your night action below. Nobody talks until dawn.
night.peek: Hold to peek — your secret role
night.lone: Lone wolf — peek at one center card?
night.insomniac: You'll check your card at dawn.
info.robber: You stole from {name} — you are now: {role}.
day.title: Talk. Accuse. Lie.
day.body: Remember: your card may have been swapped. You might not BE what you were dealt.
day.peek: Hold to peek — your night recap
day.vote: Your vote ({have}/{n} in — hidden until all are in)
